description: Fixtures for check_plan_freshness (ADR-0011 s6). Each case: a plan proposed on plan_html at source version 1, checked against current_html at current_version. Blocks come from the Phase 1 extract_blocks; the test builds the plan locator from plan_html (block found by anchor + occurrence_index; context_hash = sha256 of that block's text) and cross-checks plan_locator below.

conventions.reasons_include: every listed reason must be reported
conventions.reasons_include_any: at least one of these must be reported (spec-ambiguous cases)
conventions.reasons_exclude: none of these may be reported
conventions.expect_block_id_changed: the anchor block's ordinal id differs in current_html (block_id is only a hint)
